author: reek
body: What is left here after the kernel xHCI driver was retired. `Usb` and `UsbAudio` survive it: `Usb` holds the descriptor and setup-packet structures that `UsbHid` needs, and `UsbHid` is cited by real `codex/os/dev` chapters. The TRB and speed-name cases that used to sit alongside these belonged to the retired driver and went with it.

author: reek
body: `usb-audio-frame` is here rather than in `hda-codec-test` because that test covers every other `UsbAudio` entry point and not this one; it would have been the only casualty of deleting this file.
